summary:
- Document is for ultrasonic examination procedure of full penetration welds in materials over 8mm thick.
- ASME codes and standards are referenced.
- Equipment requirements include pulse-echo ultrasonic equipment capable of frequencies from 1 MHz to 5 MHz.
- Surface preparation involves removing weld spatter, irregularities, and foreign material.
- Calibration blocks are used for distance and sensitivity calibration.
- Weld material preparation is required if the surface finishing does not allow a correct examination.
- Temperature differential between calibration and examination surfaces should be within 25ºF (14ºC).
- Ultrasonic equipment must be calibrated at least once a year or before first use.
- Calibration checks screen height linearity and amplitude control linearity according to ASME standards.
- Straight beam and angle beam calibrations involve adjusting the time base and gain control.
- Calibration frequency includes initial calibration, changes in transducers/equipment/material/thickness, end-of-test checks, and operator changes.
- Examination guidelines include moving speed, overlap, evaluation method, and exploration requirements.
summary_points: Document is for ultrasonic examination procedure of full penetration welds in materials over 8mm thick.
ASME codes and standards are referenced.
Equipment requirements include pulse-echo ultrasonic equipment capable of frequencies from 1 MHz to 5 MHz.
Surface preparation involves removing weld spatter, irregularities, and foreign material.
Calibration blocks are used for distance and sensitivity calibration.
Weld material preparation is required if the surface finishing does not allow a correct examination.
Temperature differential between calibration and examination surfaces should be within 25ºF (14ºC).
Ultrasonic equipment must be calibrated at least once a year or before first use.
Calibration checks screen height linearity and amplitude control linearity according to ASME standards.
Straight beam and angle beam calibrations involve adjusting the time base and gain control.
Calibration frequency includes initial calibration, changes in transducers/equipment/material/thickness, end-of-test checks, and operator changes.
Examination guidelines include moving speed, overlap, evaluation method, and exploration requirements.
Angle beam examination involves exploring adjacent base material to detect potential reflectors.
The procedure involves ultrasonic examination in two directions: parallel and transverse to the weld.
Angle of the transducer is determined by the examination direction and geometry of the weld.
Acceptance criteria include discontinuities exceeding 20% of the reference level or specific dimensions for linear defects.
Final reports must document various details including job number, equipment used, and evaluation results.
Informe de inspección por ultrasonido con detalles técnicos.
Equipo de ensayo incluye modelo, medio, cola celulosa y bloque de calibración.
Calibración del equipo con transductor, reflector, sensibilidad máxima y ganancia.
Observaciones sobre indicaciones observadas en el material examinado.
Resultados de la evaluación: aceptado o rechazado según criterios establecidos.
